_comment: Captured telemetry SERIES (Milestone 5C) — real consecutive rows from the
loaded database, in the JSON-safe shape telemetry.records.ts produces. This
is what makes series.ts and the derived path exercisable with no database,
the same way telemetry-records.json exercises the single-reading path and
src/services/portal/fixtures/ exercises the normalizers.
PROVENANCE. gps is the first six rows of gps_telemetry for vehicle
TK-51105-02AZ-179386 (2026-06-16), ordered oldest first exactly as a windowed
read returns them. No value was altered and none was invented.
WHAT THIS SERIES SHOWS.
- Six distinct measurement times, so ordering and span are real: the window
runs 08:21:41.458Z to 08:54:41.458Z, a span of 33 minutes.
maximum, mean, change and trend are all distinguishable from one another.
A fixture where every value matched would let a wrong operation pass.
- The samples are IRREGULARLY spaced — 60s, 640s, 60s, 720s, 500s — which is
precisely why `mean` is documented as a sample mean and not a time-weighted
one. The two differ on this series.
- ignition is false in every row while the vehicle is moving, the
contradiction docs/DATA-IMPORT.md §7 records and the reason ignition is
exposed as no quantity at all.
canFlat is the last-known-value hazard, captured from can_telemetry for
TK-51105-23IY-141757: three rows whose `soc` signal never refreshed. Their
signal timestamps DO differ, so they are three measurements rather than one —
but the value is identical in all three, which is what makes a trend over
them a true zero rather than an artefact. A vehicle whose signal timestamps
were also identical would collapse to one sample and report no_time_span.
